{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for confounding: cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment
print('Cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment:\n', pd.crosstab(sales['channel'], sales['customer_segment']))

# Check for confounding: cross-tabulation of channel and customer_age
print('\nChannel vs customer_age (mean):\n', sales.groupby('channel')['customer_age'].mean())"}
